text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан runs until every last bit of
her
strength is used up.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She lets out a sigh, relieved to see that
all of her
hard work hasn't been in vain.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After praising her, Ines Fujin suggests
that they
race against each other again
at the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ryan, though feeling the urge to start
preparing
for the next race, finds herself
basking in the
glory of her Satsuki Sho
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
